Committee: Banking and Insurance
Sponsor: Shelnutt
Analyst: Julie Knight
Date: 02/08/2021
FISCAL NOTE
Senate Bill 26 as introduced would require property and casualty insurers to submit an annual Statement of Actuarial Opinion, pursuant to NAIC standards, unless exempted by the Commissioner of Insurance as provided in the NAIC annual instructions. This bill could increase the administrative obligations of the Department of Insurance by a small undetermined amount to approve or deny applications for exemption from this requirement.
Shay Shelnutt, Chairperson
Banking and Insurance

Senate Bill 26 as introduced and as amended and reported by the Committee on Banking and Insurance would require property and casualty insurers to submit an annual Statement of Actuarial Opinion, pursuant to NAIC standards, unless exempted by the Commissioner of Insurance as provided in the NAIC annual instructions. This bill could increase the administrative obligations of the Department of Insurance by a small undetermined amount to approve or deny applications for exemption from this requirement.

Committee: Insurance
Sponsor: Shelnutt
Analyst: Julie Knight
Date: 02/19/2021
FISCAL NOTE
Senate Bill 26 as passed the Senate would require property and casualty insurers to submit an annual Statement of Actuarial Opinion, pursuant to NAIC standards with certain exceptions. This bill could increase the administrative obligations of the Department of Insurance by a small undetermined amount to approve or deny applications for exemption from this requirement.
Kerry Rich, Chair
Insurance
